data.description: Welcome to Dubai Industrial City: A Center of Innovation and Growth

data.answer:
As a subsidiary of Dubai Holding, TECOM Group is dedicated to expanding its free zone operations to include over 700 companies by 2026. The focus will be on developing factories that support diverse sectors through eco-friendly practices. These facilities will emphasize the use of renewable energy, enhanced waste management, and water conservation to promote sustainability.

Commercial Opportunities at Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City offers a comprehensive array of commercial properties tailored to meet the diverse needs of businesses across various sectors. This dynamic area provides state-of-the-art facilities designed for optimal operation, ensuring that every business housed here benefits from the meticulously planned infrastructure.

Warehouses: The warehouses in Dubai Industrial City are high-capacity, ready-to-use spaces ranging from 5,000 to 11,000 sq. ft. They are perfect for storing a wide array of items, including general storage, cold storage, chemicals, and light industrial goods. Notable facilities like Arena Storage offer modern features such as advanced fire protection systems, round-the-clock security, ample parking, designated loading areas, and internal lighting setups.

Industrial Land: Available for long-term lease, the industrial land in this free zone is fully equipped with essential utilities and robust infrastructure. These plots offer seamless access to nearby ports and major roadways, making them ideal for industrial development.

Workers' Accommodation: To support the thriving industrial activities, Dubai Industrial City provides well-appointed residential facilities for workers. These accommodations are close to essential services like supermarkets, healthcare facilities, restaurants, and various leisure options, ensuring a comfortable living environment for residents.

Showrooms: The showrooms feature flexible layouts that are well-suited for businesses needing a combination of administrative, logistic, and storage capabilities. This versatility makes them highly sought after by a range of commercial enterprises.

Open Yards: For businesses that require outdoor storage solutions, the open yards are securely fenced and monitored with 24-hour security. They are typically used for storing construction materials and vehicles.

Retail Spaces: Dubai Industrial City also hosts retail outlets, which are strategically located to maximize business growth potential, attracting both foot traffic and partnerships.

Commercial Offices: Referred to as commercial spaces, these modern offices are situated in contemporary buildings equipped with a variety of facilities to cater to the needs of corporate entities.

Key Enterprises in Dubai Industrial City: Some of the notable companies operating within this vibrant industrial hub include Barakat Quality Plus, Silver Line Gate Group, Abdul Munem Al Rashed Foodstuff, Adnan Nawaz Transport by Heavy Trucks, and Chemex Hygiene Concepts. These enterprises highlight the industrial city’s role as a critical player in Dubai’s economic landscape.

Dubai Industrial City offers a diverse range of properties tailored to business needs, from expansive warehouses and industrial plots to modern offices and retail spaces. Warehouses, available in sizes from 5,000 to 11,000 sq. ft., are equipped with advanced facilities including fire protection and 24-hour security, making them ideal for various storage and manufacturing requirements. 

Industrial lands are ready for development, boasting full utility access and strategic connectivity to major transport routes. Additionally, the area provides flexible showroom layouts and secure open yards, catering to a wide spectrum of commercial activities, all within a meticulously planned infrastructure to foster business growth and operational efficiency.

Properties for Rent in Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City offers a range of rental properties, particularly apartments that cater to singles and families. For those interested, a 1-bedroom apartment typically starts at AED 30,000 per year, providing affordable luxury with modern amenities.

Properties for Sale in Dubai Industrial City

Investing in Dubai Industrial City means accessing a growing market of industrial properties, including warehouses and factory units. Residential properties are also available, with 1-bedroom apartments starting from AED 400,000, offering a valuable investment in Dubai’s growing industrial sector.

more_info.question: What to Expect When Living in Dubai Industrial City

data.answer:
Residents of Dubai Industrial City enjoy a lifestyle that combines urban conveniences with the tranquility of a less congested part of Dubai. The area is evolving rapidly, with increased amenities such as retail centers, recreational facilities, and dining options. Living here allows residents to benefit from the proximity to major industrial and commercial hubs while enjoying a peaceful residential environment.

Public Transportation in Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City offers convenient transportation options for both public and private commuters. Public transport within the area includes Bus F35, which provides several stops linking to central Dubai, and the nearest metro station, Expo City Metro Station, is a 20-minute drive away. 

For those traveling by private vehicle, the area is well-connected by major highways including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), Al Fayah Road (E75), and Emirates Road (E611). These roads provide easy access to neighbouring cities, with Abu Dhabi and Dubai both less than an hour's drive away.

Supermarkets in Dubai Industrial City

Madinat San Marco Supermarket, Fathima Supermarket, and Sunrise City Supermarket serve as convenient shopping destinations for residents of Dubai Industrial City, catering to their day-to-day grocery needs right within the community. These local supermarkets offer a variety of products, from fresh produce to household essentials, ensuring that residents have easy access to all their basic necessities without having to travel far.

Shopping Malls in Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City has recently expanded its community amenities with the addition of Sapphire Mall, a new 215,000 square foot shopping center designed to meet the diverse shopping and dining needs of its residents and visitors. This two-story mall, developed through an investment exceeding AED 100 million, represents the first major retail project completed by Dubai Industrial City. It hosts a variety of retail stores and dining options, enhancing the convenience and quality of life for the community.

Schools in and Near Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City is primarily a commercial area, but it also offers access to several reputable schools in the nearby Dubai Investments Park, just 20 minutes away. Schools such as Greenfield International School, which offers an International Baccalaureate curriculum, along with British Columbia Canadian School, Bright Riders School Dubai, and Nibras International School, provide diverse educational options. This makes Dubai Industrial City not only suitable for businesses but also conducive for families seeking quality education for their children.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City hosts several mosques throughout the area, catering to the daily and congregational prayer needs of its Muslim residents. For Christian community members, a short drive of about 20 to 25 minutes to Jebel Ali offers access to several churches, including the United Christian Church of Dubai, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, and St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church. Additionally, Sikh residents can visit Guru Nanak Darbar, the Sikh Gurudwara located in Jebel Ali, ensuring diverse religious facilities are conveniently accessible.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Dubai Industrial City

NMC Royal Hospital, the nearest hospital to Dubai Industrial City, spans 17,695 sq. ft. and offers premium healthcare services, including a pharmacy and round-the-clock emergency and ambulance services. Additionally, for routine check-ups, Access Clinic and Aster Clinic are conveniently located nearby, ensuring residents have quick and easy access to medical care. These facilities collectively enhance the healthcare landscape within the area, providing comprehensive medical services to the community.

Dubai Industrial City Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Industrial City, situated on the outskirts of Dubai, offers strategic proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, facilitating easy access and connectivity. Nearby, Dubai Investments Park and the Jebel Ali Area are also readily accessible, enhancing the community’s appeal for businesses and residents alike. This location serves as an ideal hub for industrial and logistical operations, leveraging its closeness to major transportation and business zones.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Industrial City

data.answer:
Dubai Industrial City offers a variety of activities for residents and visitors. The area is primarily an industrial hub, but nearby attractions provide opportunities for leisure and recreation. Residents can explore outdoor parks, fitness centers, and gyms for an active lifestyle. For dining, there are several restaurants and cafes in and around the community, offering diverse cuisine options. Additionally, the close proximity to Dubai Parks and Resorts and Ibn Battuta Mall provides entertainment options such as theme parks, cinemas, and shopping. Overall, Dubai Industrial City combines work-life balance with easy access to major leisure destinations nearby.

Restaurants in and Near Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City offers several local dining options such as Sand Marco Restaurant, Maroof Desert Cafeteria, and Sarhad Darbar Restaurant, popular among those working nearby. These eateries are located slightly away from the residential area.

For a more upscale dining experience, residents can head to Riverland Dubai within Dubai Parks and Resorts. This area features various casual dining spots, including Al Mashowa, Viva Ristorante, and Bol Gappa.

These restaurants provide a range of choices for both quick meals and more elaborate dining experiences for community members.

Beaches Near Dubai Industrial City

Dubai Industrial City is located on the outskirts of Dubai, requiring a minimum 30-minute drive to reach the beach.
The nearest beaches are JBR Beach and Al Sufouh Beach, both popular destinations. These beaches offer amenities like playgrounds, restaurants, and fitness facilities, making them ideal for relaxation and leisure.

Hotels in Dubai Industrial City

Hotels like the Courtyard by Marriott and the Premier Inn Dubai Investments Park offer comfortable accommodations for visitors and business travelers.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Dubai Industrial City

Residents of Dubai Industrial City can enjoy nearby leisure options, including the famous Dubai Parks and Resorts, located just 20 minutes away via Sheikh Zayed Road. This massive park, spanning 25 million square feet, features over 100 rides across four distinct theme parks, catering to all age groups.

A significant advantage of the community is its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport. This makes travel convenient, particularly for frequent flyers and professionals working in Dubai Industrial City, as they can reach the airport quickly without dealing with long commutes.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

The community primarily comprises commercial areas, so pampering amenities are limited. Fitness enthusiasts can visit Mia Fitness Centre, approximately 16 minutes away from the residential area. For salon services, residents have access to Cool Colors Gents Salon and Better Cut Gents Salon, both conveniently located within the community.
As an industrial area, some parts of Dubai Industrial City may experience noise. However, residential zones are designed to minimize this, ensuring a comfortable living environment.

Can I start a business in Dubai Industrial City? 

Absolutely, Dubai Industrial City is designed to facilitate business operations, particularly in manufacturing, logistics, and light industry sectors. It offers various plots and ready-to-use facilities tailored for different business needs.

Are there any community events or networking opportunities in Dubai Industrial City? 

Yes, Dubai Industrial City hosts various community events and networking opportunities aimed at fostering connections among businesses and professionals within the area.

What leisure facilities are available to residents of Dubai Industrial City? 

Residents have access to local community centers, parks, and recreational facilities designed to enrich the community life within the industrial city.

How eco-friendly is Dubai Industrial City? 

Dubai Industrial City is committed to sustainability, with several initiatives aimed at reducing the environmental impact of its operations, including waste management systems and energy-efficient buildings.

What kind of security measures are in place in Dubai Industrial City? 

The area is equipped with 24-hour security services, including CCTV surveillance and security personnel, ensuring a safe environment for both residents and businesses.

Are there facilities for international companies in Dubai Industrial City? 

Yes, the area is well-equipped to accommodate international firms, offering various facilities and services that meet global standards and are suitable for international business operations.

How does living in Dubai Industrial City compare to other industrial areas in Dubai? 

Dubai Industrial City offers a unique blend of industrial and residential facilities, making it more comprehensive and integrated compared to other industrial areas in Dubai. It provides better amenities and access to major transport routes, enhancing both living and business conditions.

data.content:
Dubai Industrial City is a dedicated economic zone strategically positioned to bolster industrial activities across diverse sectors. Situated adjacent to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and near Al Maktoum International Airport, it boasts an advantageous location close to Jebel Ali port. This area is meticulously planned to support the logistics, manufacturing, and light industry sectors with state-of-the-art infrastructure, accommodating startups to large companies. Currently, it houses over 300 companies, underscoring its role as a central part of Dubai's industrial advancement.

In addition to commercial properties, Dubai Industrial City presents a broad selection of residential options. The community offers a variety of villas and apartments for rent and sale, making it accessible at relatively affordable prices. This mixed-use development not only facilitates business operations but also ensures a comfortable lifestyle for residents, blending urban conveniences with the tranquility of a less congested district.

As a vital component of Dubai’s economic framework, Dubai Industrial City creates a dynamic environment that fosters business growth and offers a unique lifestyle. The availability of high-quality residential properties alongside luxurious amenities caters to a diverse population, ensuring that both personal and professional lives thrive. This harmonious blend of industrial and residential offerings makes Dubai Industrial City a distinctive and attractive place to live and work.

nodes.title: Samana South Haven
nodes.about:
Samana South Haven Dubai South is a six-floor residential development in Dubai Industrial City by Samana Developers, offering studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. Set within one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities and future expansion zones, the project combines well-planned homes, open surroundings, convenient connectivity, and strong potential for high capital appreciation.

Samana South Haven by Samana Developers brings together comfortable homes and lifestyle-focused amenities, including an infinity adult pool, pool deck, kids’ play area, indoor and outdoor gyms, and an outdoor cinema. Carefully chosen materials and functional layouts complement a well-connected setting designed for convenient everyday living.

nodes.title: Terva Homes
nodes.about:
Terva Homes by Al Mizan Group is a residential development offering limited units. Located in Dubai Industrial City, the project features 20 three-bedroom townhouses and 4 four-bedroom villas, including two large-format villas with expansive plot sizes and built-up areas. Each villa at Terva Homes comes with its own private swimming pool, a defining feature that enhances privacy and long-term residential appeal.

Scheduled for handover in Q2 2027, Terva Homes Dubai combines architectural harmony with functional layouts across ground and first floors. The community is supported by a host of amenities, including a universal clubhouse, a gym, separate swimming pools for children and adults, and more. Prospective buyers can choose from two flexible payment plans.

nodes.title: Coventry Curves 2
nodes.about:
Coventry Curve at Dubai Industrial City is a contemporary residential development located within Dubai South, designed to balance urban functionality with lifestyle comfort. Rising across six floors and comprising 246 residences, the project by GFS Developments features studio and one-bedroom apartments supported by curated leisure amenities and thoughtful architectural detailing.

Coventry Curve by GFS Developments is positioned to appeal to both end users and investors seeking long-term value. With a competitive entry supported by a 5% down payment, lifestyle-driven amenities, and strong fundamentals, the project offers promising capital appreciation potential within a rapidly evolving district.

nodes.title: SAMANA Hills South
nodes.about:
Located in Dubai South’s dynamic Dubai Industrial City, Samana Hills South presents a compelling residence by Samana Developers. Offering studio, 1 and 2 bedroom apartments, this thoughtfully designed project seamlessly blends industry-centric convenience with resort-style luxury. Residents can enjoy standout amenities such as an outdoor cinema, wellness lounge, and aqua gym & spa, crafting an elevated lifestyle.

With its prime connectivity to major arterial roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, the development boasts over 30 resort-style amenities, attractive pricing, and a flexible, convenient payment plan. Samana Hills South in Dubai offers a strategic investment opportunity designed to appeal to investors and end-users seeking quality, lifestyle, and value.

nodes.title: Al Haseen Residence
nodes.about:
Al Haseen Residence 1 this is distinguished 6-storey residential complex by Dugasta that redefines urban living with thoughtful designs and plain spaces harmoniously integrated with nature.

Nestled in a tranquil setting, Al Haseen invites residents to wander and wonder amidst the serenity of their surroundings. This building offers a variety of modern living spaces, including 1-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom apartments, and studios. Each residence is meticulously crafted to blend simplicity with elegance, and the interior finishing stands out for its comfort and the ability for residents to decorate their homes to their taste.

Residents of Al Haseen enjoy access to a range of amenities including a fully equipped gym for fitness enthusiasts, a refreshing swimming pool for relaxation, and ample parking for convenience.

Strategically located in Dubai Industrial City, Al Haseen offers easy access to key destinations: Dubai Investment Park is 10-12 minutes away, Palm Jebel Ali and Jumeirah Village Circle are 20-25 minutes away, District 2020 — 15-20 minutes away, Dubai Sports City is 20-25 minutes away. For those who enjoy diverse shopping experiences, Ibn Battuta Mall (15-20 minutes) and Mall of the Emirates (20-25 minutes) are also conveniently located, providing a wide array of stores, restaurants, and entertainment options. This strategic location makes Al Haseen an ideal place to live, combining comfort with easy access to essential amenities.

Whether you're drawn to the tranquility of nature or the vibrancy of urban life, Al Haseen provides a perfect living balance.

nodes.title: Dezire South
nodes.about:
Dezire South is a comfortable 2-storey residential complex consisting of two classically designed buildings. The exterior of Dezire South is marked by clean lines and simple architecture, with large windows that allow natural light to flood into each apartment. The buildings are painted in a crisp white and sophisticated gray palette, enhancing the contemporary look. Offering ready-to-move studios, as well as 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, this project represents a smart investment for those seeking a blend of modern living and tranquil surroundings. The complex boasts a contemporary design aesthetic, masterfully crafted to be detailed and elegant. Each residence is thoughtfully designed with elegance and style, creating a serene residential oasis. The well-maintained grounds feature lush green spaces accented with palm trees, providing a refreshing ambiance and a perfect place to relax and unwind.

Dezire South offers a range of amenities designed to enhance the living experience of its residents. These include a state-of-the-art gym, walking paths and balconies in each apartment. These amenities provide residents with opportunities to maintain an active lifestyle, unwind after a long day, and enjoy quality time with family and friends without leaving the comfort of their home environment.

Strategically located in Dubai Industrial City, Dezire South provides residents with unparalleled convenience, being moments away from retail, shopping, cultural, and leisure experiences. It is just 2 minutes to Dubai Industrial Park, 8 minutes to Logistic City, 8 minutes to Expo City, 12 minutes to YIWU Market, Dubai Parks and Resorts, and 11 minutes to Al Maktoum Airport.
